bosses.name: Olga
bosses.strategy:
As before, Olga's Black Fog attack will do MAJOR damage to your party, as
well as Poison each one of them, so it's a good idea to come in with
Cosmic Bracelets equipped. Her normal attacks don't do too much damage,
but her Icy Breath, Rock Storm and Lightning attacks will also both do
quite a bit of damage to your entire party, so be careful. Watch out if
she uses Mind Assault to steal your MP, as you'll want to recover it
immediately if she takes too much.
Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit and use his Ignition to boost his attack, then
have him attack as normal. With his attacked laced with Alice's Holy
Edge, he'll be doing MAJOR damage. Of course, have Alice use Holy Edge to
start with on Yuri, then have her on healing duty. Have Halley use Air
Shot every round, helping Alice heal as needed.
If you have it, have Alice take advantage of her Arc spell and just heal
every round, it makes this battle MUCH easier.
If you're unable to keep up with healing while trying to dish out the
damage, AND if Alice doesn't have Arc, then have Yuri fuse into Baldo
instead of Ifrit, using his healing spell to take care of the party while
Alice and Halley use Blessed Light and Air Shot to make up the
difference.

notes.text: I recommend taking the time to get your level 2 Earth, Wind, and Dark Fusions for Yuri, if you haven't already. For me, all I needed was just the Earth Fusion. With sets of 5 Buggs in this area, if you like, you could try fighting them enough to get your level 3 Dark Fusion, Czernobog, since you should already have the Dark Gravestone.
The next boss uses Silence, and the one after that uses Poison, so make sure to equip Cosmic Bracelets and/or your Crucifix.
If you're close to level 35 for Alice, then I strongly recommend fighting a bit more to reach 35 so she can learn the Arc spell. It'll greatly help out in the next boss battle.

Take a few steps forward, and you'll be told that you're not allowed here.

—————————————————————————————
   [1] Okay, we'll leave.
   [2] Get out of our way!
—————————————————————————————

Choose 2 to have to take on a set of Specters. Watch the following scenes, then
check the small shack where the guards were to find a chest containing a
[_LAUREL SLINGSHOT_] for Halley. Go just to the right of that area behind the
pillar on the right to find another chest, this one containing a
[_DEMONWARDNCKLACE_]. Make your way inside, and take out another set of
Specters that come at you.

After they're finished, go to the top of the screen and examine the sparkling
object in the northwest corner to find a [_BRONZE COIN_]. Go east to the next
area, taking on another set of Specters. Keep going right, opening the chest at
the right side of the room for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Go down into the next
room, note the torture chair, and continue south to what appears to be the last
room.

Move west to take on another set of two Specters, taking them out as well. Move
to the head of the body and examine it for the [_HEART KEY_], then examine the
sparkling object above the body, beside the table for the [_SILVER COIN_].
There's nowhere else to go right now, so let's go back to the first area inside
the hospital to unlock some doors.

The room in the bottom-right corner of the area will now open with the Heart
Key, so head inside and open the two chests, a [_KEY TO SUCCESS_], and a
[_CLUB KEY_]. Leave this room and head into the next room, opening the chest in
here for a rare and welcome [_FRUIT OF YGGDRASIL_]. Leave this room and go
north into the next hallway.

Enter the first door on the top-left, getting the [_DIAMOND KEY_] out of the
chest, then head east two doors to the next room. Check the sparkling object on
the ground near the bench on the upper wall for the [_GOLD COIN_], then exit
and enter the last room on the right, where you'll find another sparkling
object in roughly the same area as the last, the [_PLATINUM COIN_].

Make your way back to the innermost room that you've reached so far, the one
with the Save Point. Drop the Bronze Coin in the upper-right vase, the Platinum
Coin in the lower-right vase, the Gold Coin in the lower-left, and the Silver
Coin in the upper-left, allowing a new passage to open. SAVE YOUR GAME.

  NOTE     The next boss uses Silence, and the one after that uses Poison, so
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   make sure to equip Cosmic Bracelets and/or your Crucifix.

When you're ready, go down the staircase to the next area and examine the huge
door for a scene and a sub-boss battle.

|  needed.                                                                    |

After the battle, Halley will temporarily leave your party. Make your way back
upstairs, then head to the hallway just past the torture chair. You can now
finally enter the second door from the left, so go inside, then examine the
chest for the [_DUNGEON KEY_]. Watch a short scene with Halley, then when you
regain control, check the chest once again for the [_FIRE GRAVESTONE_]. Feel
free to use the bed in here as an Inn to recover your HP and MP.

  NOTE     If you're close to level 35 for Alice, then I strongly recommend
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   fighting a bit more to reach 35 so she can learn the Arc spell.
           It'll greatly help out in the next boss battle.

When you're ready, head back to the room with the Save Point and SAVE, then go
back downstairs, unlock the door, and take on Olga for the last time!

Here in the London Rats' hideout, make your way downstairs and use the Save
Point. Make note of a new path to your left; it leads to a Pit Fight hosted by
Sharon! If you talk to her at all, you'll have to battle a random set of
enemies alone with Yuri. Her power isn't very stable yet, so you won't be able
to engage in the actual Pit Fight like you did with Mr. Zhen, but you will in
time.

Go back into the previous room and talk to Joshua to receive the
[_OATH GRAIL_]; if you're going for the good ending, then it's critical that
you get this item. Leave the hideout, then make your way toward the entrance of
the city for an event with Halley, which will eventually lead to you
controlling Alice. Choose to enter Rouen.

As Alice, go down the alley and examine the back door to the church. Do a quick
Push Ring to open the door, then go to the altar room for a quick scene. Next,
go to the confessionals on the right side. Go into the back confessional here
and examine the wall, where you'll have to complete a Spin Ring 3. Once it's
done, you'll finally know the story between Roger Bacon and Albert Simon, and
you'll see a picture of Father Hans Doyle and Cardinal Albert Simon... Leave
the confessional for another event, then you'll regain control in London.

'—————————————'———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————'

After the quick scene, choose your party. Put Halley in it to start with so we
can obtain a better weapon for him. Make your way downstairs and talk to
Joshua, where you'll receive the [_IMPROVED SLINGSHOT_].

Now you can make your way to the Inn and talk to Meiyuan to choose the party
you want for the upcoming events. I'll be taking Yuri, Alice, and Margarete.
Once you're ready, head outside.

Out on the World Map, go out to the Britain Map to see a new destination open
up: the Nemeton Monastery.

Now... There are a few quick things to do before we go to the next dungeon. If
you wish to just continue the story, go to W-2-12 - Nemeton Monastery (1).
Otherwise, continue reading.
